integrity: The stated finite identities and logarithmic transition have direct proofs. A standalone exact-state recursion checks the finite identities; finite checks are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal coupon probabilities, first full collection only; no nonuniform analogue, CLT, or constant-order threshold correction proved. The singleton special case was covered in 2003; some exact mixed moments could be latent in general historical generating functions.
title: Logarithmic sign transition for completion-time covariance with terminal coupon multiplicities
